title: Strawberry Beverage Powder, Dry Mix, Not Reconstituted

content.title: About
content.content: Strawberry beverage powder is a concentrated dry mix designed to create a flavorful strawberry drink without adding water. The powder contains dried strawberry extracts, sugar, flavorings, and stabilizers, delivering a rich taste and aroma.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The powder retains over 90 % of the vitamin C found in fresh strawberries thanks to low‑temperature drying.
Being dry, it is easy to store and transport and does not require refrigeration.
Natural strawberry aroma is often enhanced with natural essential oils rather than artificial flavors.
The mix can be used not only for drinks but also in baking, desserts, and yogurts as a flavoring agent.
Sugar levels are adjusted for different markets, with low‑sugar versions available.

items.title: Rich in antioxidants
items.content: Strawberries contain polyphenols and anthocyanins that help combat free radicals.

items.title: Supports immune function
items.content: Vitamin C preserved in the powder aids the immune system.

items.title: Low in calories when used moderately
items.content: A small serving provides a tasty drink without a large calorie load.

items.title: Source of dietary fiber
items.content: Some formulations are fortified with fiber to aid digestion.

items.title: Promotes skin health
items.content: Vitamin C and antioxidants support collagen synthesis, benefiting skin.

items.title: Strawberry allergy
items.content: Individuals allergic to strawberries may react to the powder.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Certain versions contain high sugar levels, which may be unsuitable for diabetics.

items.title: Additive sensitivity
items.content: Stabilizers and flavorings can cause sensitivity in some people.

items.title: Overconsumption
items.content: Excessive intake can lead to unnecessary calories and sugar.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Mix 1–2 teaspoons of powder with 200 ml of cold water and stir or shake until fully dissolved. The powder can also be added to smoothies, yogurt, oatmeal, or incorporated into cake and muffin batters for a strawberry flavor.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the powder in a sealed container in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Properly stored, it remains fresh for 12 months. After opening, use within 3 months for best quality.
